messages:
viv: Power out at the ground floor but roof deck has sun + portable Starlink, so hammock office activated. photos incoming :ocean: :hamster: 
ash: Hammock office? yes. pics pls :camera_with_flash: 
viv: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F11111/roof-hammock.jpg (yes i'm wearing headphones and a raincoat)
nora: Love the vibe. how's the Starlink holding up up there? latency?
viv: ~40-60ms, generally steady. streaming a meeting on low-res and terminal work is smooth. download ~90 Mbps, upload ~12 Mbps.
ben: pro tip: put a small non-slip mat under the laptop stand. also secure the power bank and keep snacks in a ziplock.
ash: neighbor's squirrel tried to borrow the ethernet cable. chaos. uploaded a gif. :squirrel: 
viv: squirrel stole a zip tie and tried to use it as a swing. whole thing was adorable and terrifying. :sweat_smile: 
infra-bot: Reminder: personal satellite terminals may still traverse untrusted networks. Do not attach personal devices to corporate VLANs; request infra if you need an approved remote endpoint.
viv: noted infra-bot. all work traffic is via our VPN and SSH. no bridging.
nora: vote: should we add "hammock + Starlink" to the WFH emergency kit gallery? thumbs?
ben: +1. add tip: tie down cables and secure snacks. also bring a tarp if forecast looks dodgy.
ash: +1 from me. add a line: "do not feed the squirrels company snacks" :laughing: 
viv: i'll add a 1-paragraph how-to and pics. TL;DR: roofdeck hammock + Starlink = surprisingly pleasant emergency office. bring zip ties, tarp, and a squirrel deterrent. end of thread.
